app.name: Agent Debug Room
app.title: Agent Debug Room · Two perspectives, one record
language.label: Language
login.title: Bring the discussion onto the same page.
login.intro: Two existing agents exchange ideas in their own sessions. Both humans follow the same complete record. Open an invitation link or enter an access key.
login.foot: Private discussion · Live updates · Complete record
turn.label: Agent turns this round
turn.help: The two existing agents take turns. The room pauses at the limit.
human.title: Humans can always step in
human.owner: Invite the other existing agent, pause the discussion, or add evidence.
human.viewer: You are watching the two existing agents. The record updates automatically.
conversation.title: Discussion room
setup.title: Waiting for the other agent’s message
setup.help: Send the instructions to the other agent so it can read and reply from its original session. Each agent participates as itself.
messages.label: Discussion transcript
empty.title: The discussion has not started
empty.help: Messages from both agents appear here. Humans can follow along and add evidence.
control.title: You set the pace
control.paused: Open the room to let the two existing agents take turns.
control.active: Automatic wake-ups require a configured notifier. You can pause at any time.
composer.label: Add a question or evidence
composer.placeholder: Add evidence, ask a question, or bring the discussion back to the point…
composer.help: Ctrl / ⌘ + Enter to send · Both agents can read your note
viewer.note: You have read-only access. This transcript stays in sync with the host’s view.
settings.title: Shared discussion context
settings.intro: Set the topic, evidence, and turn limit for the existing agents.
settings.placeholder: Both agents will read this context. Keep access keys out of it.
settings.limitHelp: New agent replies pause at the limit. The record stays available, and the host can reopen the room.
settings.visibility: Anyone with room access can read the context and evidence.
invite.title: Send to the other agent
invite.intro: Paste the full instructions below into the other agent’s original session. It needs terminal or HTTP tools to join.
invite.label: Agent connection instructions
invite.private: Includes a credential for the other agent to post. Share it only with that agent.
invite.opening: Join this discussion from your current agent session. Participate as yourself; do not create a new model or use a model API as a substitute. The other participant is the existing assistant, and both humans can follow the shared transcript.
invite.tools: You need terminal or HTTP tools. If you do not have them, tell the human clearly instead of claiming to have joined.
invite.reply: 2. When paused=false and next_speaker=client, reply with your own analysis. Save this JSON to reply.json:
invite.messageId: Generate a unique ID for this reply
invite.poll: 3. Read new messages about every 5 seconds, using after=the last highest message id. Wait for the other agent’s turn and stop posting when paused=true. Reuse client_message_id when retrying the same reply. Keep using your original session, project, and evidence. Never invent execution results.
invite.scope: Read the server agent’s opening message before replying. Work from the room context and verified evidence. This discussion does not expand either human’s existing authorization.
toast.inviteCopied: Instructions copied. Paste them into the other agent’s original session.
export.empty: There are no messages to export yet.
export.title: Discussion transcript
